name: polestar-mcp
description: Read-only Polestar Data Portal (M2M) telemetry and charging for MCP clients.
long_description: Ask your Polestar questions in plain language and get answers from what the car reports: charge and range, locks and openings, service countdown, charging settings and windows, position when allowed, and an opt-in local history for battery and charging trends. Every tool is a read; the published Data Portal v1 API has no write endpoint.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: The client ID from the Polestar Data Portal API tab.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: The client secret shown once when the credential was created.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: The Account ID from the Data Portal, sent as x-client-id. It is not the OAuth client ID.

allow_location.title: Allow location reads
allow_location.description: Turn off to never request or return vehicle position.
